citeAs: Hamamci, I. E., Er, S., Wang, C., et al. (2024). Developing generalist foundation models from a multimodal dataset for 3D computed tomography. arXiv preprint arXiv:2403.17834.
creator: Ibrahim Ethem Hamamci, Sezgin Er, Chenyu Wang, Furkan Almas, Ayse Gulnihan Simsek, Sewal Nil Esirgun, Irem Dogan, Omer Faruk Durugol, Benjamin Hou, Suprosanna Shit, Weicheng Dai, Murong Xu, Hadrien Reynaud, Muhammed Furkan Dasdelen, Bastian Wittmann, Tamaz Amiranashvili, Enis Simsar, Mehmet Simsar, Emine Bensu Erdemir, Abdullah Alanbay, Anjany Sekuboyina, Berkan Lafci, Ahmet Kaplan, Zhiyong Lu, Malgorzata Polacin, Bemhard Kainz, Christian Bluethgen, Kayhan Batmanghelich, Mehmet Kemal Ozdemir, Bjoem Menze
description: CT-RATE is a public dataset that pairs 50,188 reconstructed 3D chest CT volumes from 25,692 scans of 21,304 patients with corresponding English-translated radiology reports and 18 abnormality labels.
name: CT-RATE
rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 report per CT volume, plus 18 abnormality labels.
rai:annotatorDemographics: Bilingual final-year medical students (for translation review).
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The finetuned RadBERT model's precision, recall, and F1 scores were evaluated to ensure robust classification across abnormalities.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Google Translate API (for translation), RadBERT (for automated labeling).
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reports were anonymized using regular expressions, translated from Turkish to English via Google Translate API, and reviewed by bilingual medical students. 1,000 reports were manually annotated for 18 abnormalities to finetune a RadBERT model, which then automatically labeled the remaining reports.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset originates from a single geographic and clinical setting (Istanbul Medipol University Mega Hospital), which may limit generalizability to other populations.
rai:dataCollection: Non-contrast chest CT volumes and corresponding radiology text reports were collected from the database of Istanbul Medipol University Mega Hospital.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Non-contrast 3D chest CT volumes and corresponding free-text radiology reports in Turkish, structured into clinical information, technique, findings, and impression sections.
rai:dataImputationProtocol: CT volumes are center-cropped or padded to reach a consistent resolution of 480x480x240.
rai:dataLimitations: Biases inherent to a single-institution dataset; depends on specific terminology used in reports; limited to chest CT volumes.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Volumes resized to uniform spacing of 0.75 mm (x, y) and 1.5 mm (z). Converted to Hounsfield Units (HU), clipped to -1000 to 1000, and normalized to a range of -1 to 1.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Reports anonymized by removing dates and patient-doctor identifiers using regex. Translated to English. CT volumes involving contrast material or non-chest body parts were excluded. Orientation standardized.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to extend CT-RATE with multi-abnormality segmentation and localization labels in the future.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Aims to efficiently identify pathologies, reduce radiologist workload, and potentially save lives where immediate radiological expertise is unavailable.
rai:dataUseCases: Multi-abnormality detection, volume-to-volume retrieval, report-to-volume retrieval, visual question-answering, and radiology report generation.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Patient and medical professional personal information, including dates and identifiers, were removed during anonymization.
